question: Did any game status change between the 13 November read and today's read, and on which day?

information_we_lack: The reads in between (Wednesday, Thursday, Friday) and the page's own change timestamp, which is not published anywhere in the repository.

question: Which players are absent from the weekly report because they are on a reserve list rather than because they are available?
information_we_have: The weekly report as read today: 347 rows across the 28 clubs that play in Week 10.
information_we_lack: No reserve, injured-reserve or transactions list is captured anywhere in this repository, so 'not listed' is currently indistinguishable from 'healthy'.
how_to_discover_it: Capture the official transactions and reserve lists, dated, alongside each weekly read.
blocks: Every 'no injury reported' claim made for a club, and every count built on the absence of a row.

question: Who actually replaces a starter who is ruled out?
information_we_have: A transcribed depth slot for 284 of the 347 listed players (81.8 per cent), and for 55 of the 70 players ruled Out. Houston resolves 0 of 16.
information_we_lack: The other 63 listed players, including 15 ruled Out, appear on no transcribed chart, so no replacement can be named for them. No game-day inactive list and no snap count is captured.
how_to_discover_it: Capture the official game-day inactive lists and the snap counts in the official game books; only then can a replacement be confirmed rather than suspected.
blocks: The whole backup-deficiency feature (R-20, R-21, R-44).

question: Is rank order in a club depth chart a valid proxy for playing time?
information_we_have: Nothing. No measurement exists in this repository.
information_we_lack: Any evidence at all. Clubs publish their charts as unofficial and, in Houston's case, as an image.
how_to_discover_it: Join chart rank to snap share over several weeks and measure the rank-one share. Until that is done the brief's instruction to model depth from playing time is not met.
blocks: Whether depth may be used as a model input at all.

question: How often does a player carrying the Questionable designation actually play?

information_we_lack: Historical designations joined to the official inactive lists, which is the only way to turn the label into a probability.

blocks: Whether 'Questionable' can be a feature, and with what weight.

question: Which week-numbering convention is canonical, and is the venue confirmed for every Week 10 game?

question: Is there a measurable association between injury counts and performance?
information_we_have: Seven descriptive correlations over the 28 clubs that play in Week 10, both inputs officially sourced: none significant at 5 per cent, largest absolute r under 0.28.
information_we_lack: More than one week, and a within-club design rather than a cross-sectional one. n of 28 in a single week cannot separate injuries from roster quality.
how_to_discover_it: Repeat the same calculation weekly, accumulate the weeks, and only then fit anything.
blocks: Any use of injuries as a predictive input (R-16, R-43).
